gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gruppo: Distinctive from the first letter, Sniglet keeps every stroke one rope-thin width and lets its terminals stop short of curling back. Sniglet makes the statement; Gruppo carries the words, curve endings kept apart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-hanken-grotesk: Hanken Grotesk has a wire-bent look across each word, with wide channels leading into every counter. Sniglet is made to stand out; its partner is made to keep going.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-hubot-sans: Bright, modern letters: Sniglet keeps one constant pen width throughout, while Hubot Sans opens its e wide. Their clearest strength is a shared directness that never gets fussy or ornate.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Open, uncrowded mouths on the s and c make IBM Plex Sans Hebrew feel approachable, while Sniglet keeps a single-depth cut. Over pages of text, it would stay friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loo: Sturdy and sure, Sniglet keeps its bowls full at the sides, while IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped leaves its curves unclosed. But shrink the heading, and its full bowls lose their punch.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kodchasan: Punchy up top, plain below: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, while Kodchasan lets its own hang open. Sniglet grabs attention; Kodchasan keeps the lines moving without calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kosugi: Clean from the start, Kosugi gives its c an open jaw like pliers and a wire-bent look through each word. Sniglet is there to command; Kosugi is there to carry the text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kosugi-maru: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, while Kosugi Maru glows like neon tube with far-apart stroke ends. Reading on would feel smooth and glowing, line after line.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Blunt and hairline-free, Sniglet commands the top, with no thin strokes anywhere in its alphabet and a quiet, level beat. And LXGW Marker Gothic opens its c like a bracelet pulled apart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-momo-trust-sans: Punchy and self-assured, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back and holds a quiet, level beat. Momo Trust Sans adds the real hook, wide unclosed mouths on every curved letter.
